story.title: OEM/ODM cosmetics and skincare manufacturing from Taman Tekno BSD.
story.body: PT Cosmar operates from Taman Tekno BSD and provides end-to-end cosmetic and skincare contract manufacturing. Its current official website states more than 15 years of R&D experience, 300+ local brand partners, legal-support services including BPOM and Halal, and a standard MOQ of 3,000 pieces.
